review_notes: Corrected the target head of the second mippənê unit from of to because. Rule 24 forbids heading such a fixed relational phrase on one of its connectives; the accepted note's own reasoning — that no word realizes pānîm's lexeme — is what triggers rule 24's content-word clause rather than a licence to head on of.
The two mippənê phrases are rendered differently (of / because of) but are one construction each, fused under rule 30 and source-headed on the construct noun under rule 23.
